description: For every full arithmetic formula \(\varphi(x,\bar y)\) and finite ordered parameter list \(\bar y\), its native induction sentence is \[\forall\bar y\,[(\varphi(0,\bar y)\land\forall x(\varphi(x,\bar y)\to\varphi(Sx,\bar y)))\to\forall x\varphi(x,\bar y)].\] The parameters remain fixed, and every substitution protects nested binders.
